title: Second Highest Salary
scenario: Write a query to find the second highest distinct salary from the Employee table. If there is no second highest salary, return null. Return the result table as 'SecondHighestSalary'.
hint: Use a subquery to find the MAX(salary) excluding the overall MAX(salary), or use OFFSET with LIMIT.
correctQuery: SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS SecondHighestSalary;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE employee (id INT, salary INT); INSERT INTO employee VALUES (1, 100), (2, 200), (3, 300);
